features.quote: Cap at 30 minutes wall-clock (roughly 15-20 model turns before hard stop)
You have 20 iterations to do this.
Hard stop at 20 iterations or 30 min, whichever first
If a model runs out of context before 20 iterations, cap that run at iteration N and note it.
features.justification_quote: May skew instability high for long-winded models.
